## Podcasts

- [Austrian AI – Harvesting social networks for agent based modelling using NLP.](https://open.spotify.com/episode/5p3nvjuSWEfRd4EgqhXlsi) Join Manuel Pasieka on a conversation about data-driven economics and using Natural Language Processing to study the Great Resignation.
- [The Knowledge Archives](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xZFAORAuavw) – [Economic Modelling During COVID-19](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xZFAORAuavw). Join Madhav Malhotra and me on a conversation about data-driven economics and the experience of modelling the economy during Covid.
- [Complexity by the Santa Fe Institute](https://complexity.simplecast.com/episodes/15) – Modeling Labor Markets & Tech Unemployment. Join Michael Garfield and me on conversation about work, it's evolution and the upcoming challenges
- [La Arana Patona by the Intituto de Energías Renovables, UNAM. Capital humano.](http://imryt.org/radio/la-arana-patona/capital-humano) Join José de la Herrán and me on a conversation about human capital [Spanish podcast] .
